question: Where should next quarter's product effort go: access, usability, playback, or billing/support?
ranking_rule: priority_score = severity_sum = complaint_count x mean_severity over complaint+cancellation records; ties by issue_id

top_issues.name: General app dissatisfaction and poor quality
top_issues.description: Customers express overall dissatisfaction with app quality and company priorities.

examples.quote: Worst app ever they only care about money
